hero.subtitle: Welcome to my portfolio.

AboutTeaser.card1Desc: I build applications from scratch – from logic and databases to user interfaces. I independently developed and deployed my own website.
AboutTeaser.card2Desc: I focus on logical project planning. I design database structures (SQL) and write utility programs that help me with my daily tasks.
AboutTeaser.card3Desc: I don't just write code. I analyze games from a design perspective to understand what truly drives player engagement and behavior.
AboutTeaser.card4Desc: I step outside the screen. I build physical electronic circuits and integrate them with low-level code.
AboutTeaser.summary: This is just a fraction of my journey. I study Computer Science at Rzeszów University of Technology, code every day, and fear no challenge.
